title: 第一章 诺森德的寒风将吞噬你们的灵魂

content_zh:
银白骑士大踏步的走上前，手中的利刃带过一轮弯月般的闪光，向着方正砍下。他可以确信，自己的这一击毫无偏移，只要一瞬间，他就能够砍下眼前这个年轻人的头颅。
但是………
“铛！！！”
伴随着清脆的金属交击声，银白骑士手中的长剑挺在了半空，他惊讶的瞪大眼睛，看着眼前的年轻人举起右手———在他的手中，四溢的冰冷寒气逐渐凝结，化为了一把美丽而令人恐惧的长剑。
漆黑如夜色般的剑柄上，一个诡异的骷髅头死死的盯视着他，那仿佛白骨冰雪般的剑身上所散发出来的，是深入灵魂的寒冷。幽蓝色的光辉从剑身的沟壑之中浮现，哪怕仅仅只是一窥，就足以看出，这把长剑并非凡品。
“那是什么？”
“那一定就是秘宝！！”
看着这把忽然出现在方正手中的长剑，旁边的银白骑士们顿时大叫起来。反倒是黑袍盯视着眼前的这一切，忽然感觉好像有什么地方不太对劲………
“等等，情况不对，小心———！！”
还不等黑袍话音落下，只见原本半跪在地上的方正猛然跃起，他双手紧握长剑，高高举起，用力向前一挥。下一刻，就看见那把长剑毫无花假的刺入了眼前银白骑士的身体之中。
“啊啊啊———！！”
惨叫声起，被长剑刺入身体的银白骑士颤抖着大声尖叫起来，他的身体开始飞快的干瘪，灵魂的光辉从中闪耀，然后就看见一个模模糊糊的人影仿佛被什么东西拉扯一般从银白骑士的身上浮现，然后就这样旋转着被吸入了那长剑的剑身之中。
“轰———！！”
在这瞬间，咆哮的风以方正为中心骤然爆发，旋转呼啸的凛冽寒气把冲上前来的其他银白骑士统统打飞了开来。而那个黑袍也是急忙向后退开了数米远后，这才勉强抵挡住了这一轮寒气的爆发，而当暴风消失之时，他再次向着前方望去，随后长大了嘴巴，目瞪口呆。
“这，这是………”
只见在众人的面前，此刻的方正已经不复刚才那副落魄，悲惨的样子。冰冷的寒气在他的身体上四散蔓延，化为了一件银白色的盔甲。而在他的头顶上方，一个巨大的幻影凭空浮现，那是一个戴着王冠，将面孔隐藏在阴影之中的存在。他就这样坐在仿佛被万年寒冰凝结而成的王座上，冷冷的注视着眼前的敌人。哪怕只是被他的目光所注视，都给人一种似乎连灵魂都被冻结的错觉。
或许，那并不是错觉。
此刻，以方正为中心，四周的大地正在逐渐被冰霜所覆盖，花草树木开始枯萎，仿佛一切的生命都将被终结。
“好可怕的死亡之力！！”
看见这一幕，黑袍也是面色大变，他急忙向后退开，接着从怀中拿出了一个符文握在手里。可是还不等他有下一步的动作，方正似乎就已经察觉到了他的存在一般转过头来望向眼前的黑袍，接着他举起长剑，向着黑袍一指。

“哗啦！”
只是一下，黑袍整个人就这么被忽然出现的寒冰彻底冻结，他的动作还保持在握住符文的那一刻，就好像时间都在此时停止了一般。但是很快，黑袍的身体之中，一个哀嚎的模糊人形从中飞出，尖叫着被吸入了方正手中的长剑剑身之内。
“邪恶的不死生物，居然胆敢亵渎灵魂！！”
将眼前这一幕尽收眼底，其他几个银白骑士则是又惊又怒，只见他们互相对视了一眼，举起手中的长剑。
“神圣祝福！”
伴随着骑士们的怒吼，一道道柔和的光亮从他们的身体上浮现，照亮了原本漆黑昏暗的荒野。但是，这对于方正来说，似乎并没有什么用处。
“诺森德的寒风，将吞噬你们的灵魂！”
他转过头去，望向眼前的骑士，低声自语着。而伴随着方正的说话，四周呼啸的寒风骤然再一次加强，形成了一堵无形的墙壁将这些银白骑士们包裹在了其中。与此同时，大地龟裂，一具具骷髅从中爬出，它们或许曾经是在这片土地上战斗的战士，也可能只不过是埋藏在荒郊野外的平民。但是现在，它们的眼眶之中燃烧着冰冷的蓝色火焰说明了它们的身份。
“和他拼了！！我们一起上！！女神与我们同在！！”
看着眼前这越来越多的不死生物，银白骑士们面如死灰，他们感受到了那扑面而来的死亡之力，也知道他们绝对不是这股强大力量的对手，可是到了现在，他们已经无路可退———那么，就只有拼死一战！

content_en:
The silver knight strode forward, the sharp blade in his hand flashed like a crescent moon, and slashed towards Fang Zheng. He could be sure that his blow would not be deflected, and in just a moment, he would be able to chop off the head of the young man in front of him.
But......
"Cang!!!"
Accompanied by the crisp sound of metal clashing, the long sword in the silver knight's hand stood up in the air. His eyes widened in surprise as he watched the young man in front of him raise his right hand - in his hand, the overflowing cold air gradually condensed and turned into a beautiful and terrifying long sword.
On the hilt of the sword, which was as dark as night, a strange skull stared at him. The sword that looked like bones and ice radiated a coldness that penetrated deep into the soul. A faint blue light emerged from the ravine on the sword body. Even just a glimpse was enough to tell that this long sword was not extraordinary.
"What's that?"
"That must be the secret treasure!!"
Seeing the long sword that suddenly appeared in Fang Zheng's hand, the silver knights next to him suddenly shouted. On the contrary, the black robe stared at everything in front of him, and suddenly felt that something was not quite right...
"Wait, something is wrong, be careful————!!"
Before the black robe could finish his words, Fang Zheng, who was half-kneeling on the ground, suddenly jumped up. He held the sword tightly with both hands, raised it high, and swung it forward with all his strength. The next moment, he saw the long sword piercing into the body of the silver knight in front of him without any pretense.
“Ahhhh————!!”
The screams started, and the silver knight who had been stabbed into the body by the long sword trembled and screamed loudly. His body began to wither quickly, and the brilliance of his soul shone from it. Then he saw a vague figure emerging from the silver knight's body as if being pulled by something, and then he was rotated and sucked into the body of the long sword.
"Boom————!!"
At this moment, the roaring wind suddenly erupted with Fang Zheng as the center, and the whirling and biting cold air knocked away all the other silver knights who rushed forward. The man in black robe also hurriedly retreated several meters, and then barely withstood the burst of cold air. When the storm disappeared, he looked forward again, then opened his mouth and was stunned.
"This, this is..."
In front of everyone, Fang Zheng no longer looked as downcast and miserable as before. The icy cold air spread over his body, turning into a piece of silver-white armor. And above his head, a huge phantom emerged out of thin air. It was a being wearing a crown and hiding his face in the shadows. He just sat on the throne that seemed to be condensed by thousands of years of ice, staring coldly at the enemy in front of him. Even just being stared at by his eyes gave people the illusion that even their souls were frozen.
Maybe that's not an illusion.
At this moment, with Fangzheng as the center, the surrounding land is gradually being covered by frost, and the flowers, plants and trees are beginning to wither, as if all life is about to end.
"What a terrifying power of death!!"
Seeing this scene, Black Robe's expression changed drastically. He hurriedly stepped back, then took out a rune from his arms and held it in his hand. But before he could make the next move, Fang Zheng seemed to have noticed his presence and turned to look at the black robe in front of him. Then he raised his sword and pointed at the black robe.
"Wow!"
Just for a moment, Hei Pao's whole body was completely frozen by the sudden appearance of ice. His movements remained at the moment when he was holding the rune, as if time had stopped at this moment. But soon, a wailing vague humanoid figure flew out of the black robe's body, screaming and being sucked into the body of the long sword in Fang Zheng's hand.
"Evil undead creatures dare to blaspheme the soul!!"
Taking a panoramic view of the scene in front of me, several other silver-whiteThe knight was shocked and angry. They looked at each other and raised the sword in their hands.
"Holy blessing!"
Along with the roar of the knights, soft lights emerged from their bodies, illuminating the originally dark and dim wilderness. However, this seems to be of little use to Fang Zheng.
"The cold wind of Northrend will swallow your souls!"
He turned his head, looked at the knight in front of him, and whispered to himself. As Fang Zheng spoke, the howling cold wind suddenly strengthened again, forming an invisible wall that enveloped these silver knights. At the same time, the earth cracked, and skeletons crawled out. They might have been warriors who fought on this land, or they might just be civilians buried in the wilderness. But now, the cold blue flames burning in their eye sockets illustrate their identity.
"Fight with him!! Let's go together!! The goddess is with us!!"
Looking at the increasing number of undead creatures in front of them, the silver knights' faces were ashen. They felt the power of death coming towards them, and knew that they were definitely no match for this powerful force. But now, they had no way to retreat - then, they had to fight to the death!
